youtube.title: A Short cut on the beat in 3 steps: one music line, shot lengths in beats, render
youtube.description:
A Short cut on the beat: 3 steps.
1. Add a song: one music line. 2. Give each shot a length in beats. 3. Render: every cut lands on a beat. This video rendered in under 50 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
